randomSearch.statement: The displayed random-search comparison uses 1-fold T. It does not join eight validation folds or average eight test predictions. The source CSV numbers are unchanged.

protocols.elo: Full BeyondArena: 142 datasets, 497 tasks, 58-method field. Elo remains as published when filtering the display. D, T and T+E are distinct deployment regimes; FT/FTE name the objective used to select the portfolio. K=25, except TabPack K=64.
protocols.latency: Separate single-row inference measurements on 10 BeyondArena datasets: median of per-dataset median milliseconds, native serving paths. CPU trees use 16 threads; neural and in-context methods use an H100. KV cache modes are separate measurements. Timing and Elo have different evaluation scopes.
protocols.randomSearch: TabArena-51, 1-fold T deployment: select one configuration on validation and score on test. Published split metadata: outer repeat 0 / fold 0; validation = inner fold 0. All curves and horizontal references use a common random-K baseline. Synthetic reference: selected at C=N=4,000. Real-data reference: the exact TabRepo N=182, C=4,000 corner, not the best budget-envelope point. Pool curve: subsets from the original 4,000 bank. Draw curve: 200 subsets from a 16,000 bank; its 2.5–97.5% band is variation across draws, not a confidence interval. Neither curve is a direct selected-K versus random-K′ win rate.
protocols.budget: T deployment on TabArena. Envelope follows the original plotting code: maximum observed win rate in each rounded log2(C×N) budget bin, independently per bin. This is not a trajectory from a single selected run. Synthetic source uses up to C=N=4,000; TabRepo source uses up to 182 real datasets and 16,000 configurations, with C>K.
protocols.surfaces: Tuned study only: TabICLv2 prior, C×N up to 4,000×4,000; T deployment evaluated on TabArena-51. Each cell uses its selected K-subset against random K. C=K is 0.5 by construction. ci95 is the published 95% half-width.
protocols.hyperparameters: Exact K=200, T-selected portfolio configurations from the pinned Hugging Face release. Smooth curves reproduce the paper's Gaussian KDE with Scott bandwidth, reflected at both bounds in the sampling-CDF coordinate, evaluated at 300 points. Their y-axis is selected density divided by sampling density; the sampling-prior reference is 1. Native hyperparameter values are shown on a logarithmic axis for log-uniform parameters. The original 12-bin empirical histograms remain in the downloadable data. Categorical choices retain probability masses. Dropout's zero atom is separate from its continuous component. TabPrep-only parameters condition on TabPrep being enabled.
